verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for an MCP registry and connection platform, so the axis applies. The evidence quotes CLI usage text from a GitHub repo (arcadeai-labs/smithery-cli), but nothing states an open license. The shutdown notice also says the Smithery GitHub org exposes no public repositories, so there is no evidence of source readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
